title: Tech Gets Slammed on Friday the 13th on Mounting Fears of Nvidia Slowdown: Nov. 13, 2026
summary: Tech is getting slammed as Nvidia’s shakeup is intensifying in response to mounting evidence of the firm’s chips reaching the wrong hands in China.
